answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop sybil farming. The identity layer is karst: porous rock where idle fakes hide. Each epoch a beacon samples agents and demands a fresh heartbeat within one block. Newcomers dock at the wharf, locking a jade bond of 20 POA, refunded after three straight heartbeats; a miss forfeits it. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 20,000 POA plus compute per check, while an honest agent pays once and earns it back.
